name: SearchGuy.com, Inc.
summary: SearchGuy.com, Inc. delivers diverse internet-based search and advertising solutions. The company provides a comprehensive online search engine, freely available for global web users. In addition to its search capabilities, SearchGuy.com offers various advertising services designed to meet the needs of both large enterprises and small businesses. A key advertising product is "Keywords," a system that enables clients to choose specific terms to accurately represent their services or business. Furthermore, the company develops several utility tools, including SearchGuy.com Desktop 1.0 for direct desktop search access, the SearchGuy.com Toolbar for web navigation and pop-up suppression, and SearchGuyBot, an instant messaging application. SearchGuy.com was established in 2001 and is based in Mountain View, California.
